evals.prompt: 分析 trellis-plan-review 的使用情况，根据历史对话给出带评分的 Markdown 和 HTML 改进反馈。
evals.expected_output: Scan with --skill-name, score invoked sessions, preview and confirm one exact named report package, then use --name for the validated JSON, separate Markdown and HTML writes, proof-gated cleanup, browser open, and a copyable handoff prompt without editing the target skill.
assertions: Runs scan_invocations.py with scanner --skill-name
Uses execution_efficiency and instruction_fit with declared overall and grade
Previews the exact root, canonical name, input path, Markdown path, HTML path, and create-remove-open effects before any report helper
Obtains one explicit confirmation for the immutable named report package
Uses canonical --name for manage_review_input.py, write_session_review.py, and open_report.py
Creates one validated review JSON, writes Markdown and self-contained HTML separately, removes input only with complete hash proof, then opens HTML
Chat includes both report paths, a file URI fallback, and a text-fenced handoff prompt
Does not edit the target SKILL.md

evals.prompt: Review git-commit sessions. instruction_fit 没有足够证据，但 execution_efficiency 有证据，请生成报告。
evals.expected_output: Treat only instruction_fit as insufficient evidence, exclude it from that dimension mean, substitute raw 0.5 for the weighted calculation with an unverified note, and still produce a six-decimal two-dimension overall and grade after authorization.
assertions: Does not allow insufficient_evidence for execution_efficiency
Does not lower the instruction_fit mean by treating insufficient_evidence as zero
Uses Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP quantization to six places for mean, curve, and overall
Uses no third scoring item and treats invocation counts as display-only
Explains the null instruction_fit substitution under unverified

evals.prompt: Review skill sessions, but all four Claude, Grok, Codex, and Oh My Pi stores are missing.
evals.expected_output: Return bounded unrated: no-session-stores with four-platform coverage and counts, then stop.
assertions: Returns unrated: no-session-stores
Does not read private session slices or construct review JSON
Does not calculate a mean, ratio, overall, or grade
Does not call an input, report, ignore, or browser helper

evals.prompt: Scan skill-session-review history. Stores exist, but the only signals are loaded and available; there are zero invoked sessions.
evals.expected_output: Return bounded unrated: no-invoked-sessions with coverage and counts, then stop without artifacts.
assertions: Returns unrated: no-invoked-sessions
Does not score loaded or available sessions
Does not create JSON, Markdown, or HTML and does not open a browser

evals.prompt: Prepare a skill-session-review report, show me exactly what it would touch, but do not confirm anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Preview the confirmed root, canonical name, three exact paths, and create-input/create-Markdown/create-HTML/proof-remove/open effects, with zero helper calls until explicit confirmation.
assertions: Shows the complete exact report-package snapshot
Does not call any side-effect helper before explicit confirmation
Does not treat an allowed side effect as authorization

evals.prompt: I confirmed the report package, but now use a different repo root and a shorter report name.
evals.expected_output: Reject the old authorization because root and name drifted, re-derive all paths and effects, and request a fresh named-package confirmation before helpers.
assertions: Invalidates authorization on root, name, path, or effect drift
Does not refresh the snapshot silently
Does not call report helpers before a new confirmation

evals.prompt: The confirmed report target already exists. Replace it with this new review.
evals.expected_output: Stop no-clobber creation, show the exact existing path, current SHA-256, and replacement effect, then obtain a separate replacement confirmation before --replace --expected-sha256.
assertions: Does not infer replace permission from the report-package confirmation
Shows the current SHA-256 and exact target path
Uses --replace --expected-sha256 only after separate confirmation

evals.prompt: The report directory is not ignored yet. Generate the report package.
evals.expected_output: Preview the complete repo-root .gitignore candidate and obtain its own governed confirmation before the independently confirmed named report package.
assertions: Keeps .gitignore authorization separate from the report package
Uses ensure_report_ignore.py rather than an input or report helper to change .gitignore
Requires a current SHA-256 and separate confirmation for .gitignore replacement

evals.prompt: Continue from my last Claude session on the auth bug.
evals.expected_output: Route to resume-claude or the equivalent session-resume capability; do not run skill-session-review.
assertions: Does not trigger skill-session-review
Routes to session resume

evals.prompt: 优化这个仓库的 CLAUDE.md，精简上下文。
evals.expected_output: Route to claude-context-improver rather than reviewing skill sessions.
assertions: Does not trigger skill-session-review
Routes to claude-context-improver

evals.prompt: Which skills did I use last week? Give me invocation counts.
evals.expected_output: Route to a usage-count capability; do not create a session-review report.
assertions: Does not trigger skill-session-review
Does not write reports/skill-session-review

evals.prompt: 用 qiaomu-meta 根据刚才的想法直接改 trellis-plan-review 的 SKILL.md。
evals.expected_output: Route to qiaomu-meta for a separate apply turn; skill-session-review does not edit the target skill.
assertions: Does not treat the request as a skill-session-review apply operation
Does not edit the target SKILL.md through this skill
